_comment: Agent-side MCP client wiring for both connections. agent/run_agent.py builds this same shape in code from the environment; this file is the portable form other MCP hosts accept. Secrets come from the environment, never from here.
_obsidian_note: The Local REST API plugin ships its own MCP server, so no third-party wrapper is involved. It serves streamable HTTP on 27124 behind a self-signed certificate; use http://127.0.0.1:27123/mcp/ when that certificate is rejected and the plugin's plain-HTTP port is enabled.
